completion.method: Equal-weight operational completion is kept separate from governance completion so documentation cannot be counted as executed runtime behavior.

requiredEvidence: exact pull request number and state
execution result when runtime behavior is claimed
rollback evidence when production is touched
rules: Do not mark runtime work complete from a contract, schema, report, fixture, or planning artifact alone.
Do not treat a historical test result as current-baseline proof.
Do not assign a future XRI phase number from this roadmap.
Do not rewrite historical phase titles to match an earlier plan.
Update the master roadmap and God View snapshot together after each approved milestone.
No direct-to-main change and no merge without Howard's explicit approval.

milestones.name: Canonical roadmap and status baseline
milestones.objective: Create one authoritative completion model separating governance, implementation existence, current-baseline verification, historical execution, and production operation.
exitCriteria: XRI-G102 roadmap Markdown and JSON are approved and merged
Percent methodology and definition of done are locked
God View points to the approved roadmap without modifying the public status artifact
milestones.recommendedNextGateType: review, SonarQube/static verification, merge authorization, and post-merge completion reconciliation

evidence.criterion: XRI-G102 roadmap Markdown and JSON are approved and merged
Percent methodology and definition of done are locked
God View points to the approved roadmap without modifying the public status artifact

milestones.name: Current-main executable inventory
milestones.objective: Classify every executable, workflow, dependency, input, output, network call, and write target on the current main SHA.
exitCriteria: No unclassified executable or workflow remains
Superseded and active paths are distinguished
Inventory is tied to an immutable main SHA

milestones.name: Fixture-only end-to-end validation
milestones.objective: Prove the fixture pipeline passes deterministically on the then-current main baseline.
exitCriteria: Positive and failure-case tests pass
Stable identity and review-rank prohibitions are enforced
Commands, dependencies, stdout, stderr, exit code, and hashes are recorded
No live source or forbidden write occurs
milestones.recommendedNextGateType: isolated fixture execution and result-capture gate

milestones.name: Read-only live-source adapter
milestones.objective: Verify at least one allowlisted live source in read-only mode with strict limits and schema-drift handling.
exitCriteria: One allowlisted adapter passes current-baseline verification
Pagination, timeout, size limits, retry, and schema checks are evidenced
No geocoding, staging, production, registry, WordPress, or cache write occurs

milestones.name: Controlled non-production dry run
milestones.objective: Run the isolated source-to-review-package path on current main without production authority.
exitCriteria: Source, normalization, candidate identity, deduplication, validation, and audit outputs pass
Artifacts are isolated and reproducible
Zero production, public-map, WordPress, workflow, registry, or unauthorized cache writes
milestones.recommendedNextGateType: controlled dry-run authorization and result-review sequence

milestones.name: Human review and disposition
milestones.objective: Generate an actual review package, select by stable identity, and record a controlled non-authoritative disposition and decision trace.
exitCriteria: Actual input package exists
Actual stable candidate-selection record exists
Structural validation and disposition are reproducible
No automatic approval, promotion, staging, publishing, or production authority is inferred
milestones.recommendedNextGateType: input-package, candidate-selection, validation, and disposition execution gates

milestones.name: Isolated staging
milestones.objective: Build a production-shaped staging feed from disposition-approved records only.
exitCriteria: Staging manifest records lineage, inclusions, exclusions, deduplication, counts, and hashes
Production comparison is deterministic
Existing production remains untouched

milestones.name: Production canary
milestones.objective: Publish a minimal explicitly approved canary with verified backup, public-feed checks, map checks, and rollback.
exitCriteria: Pre-canary snapshot integrity verified
Minimal merge-not-replace publish succeeds
Raw feeds and public map are independently verified
Rollback restoration is demonstrated or independently validated
milestones.recommendedNextGateType: production-canary authorization, verification, and rollback gate

milestones.name: Scheduled operations and monitoring
milestones.objective: Operate repeated refresh and QA runs with explicit authorization, freshness monitoring, alerts, and no automatic production promotion.
exitCriteria: Schedule is separately authorized
Freshness, source drift, anomalies, and failures alert correctly
Run history and ownership are recorded
Workflow cannot directly push or promote by default

milestones.name: Final project closeout
milestones.objective: Audit all definition-of-done requirements and establish durable operational ownership.
exitCriteria: Operating and maintenance runbooks complete
Public status artifact current
Zero unresolved critical blockers
Zero unintended open pull requests or issues
All completion claims trace to immutable evidence
milestones.recommendedNextGateType: final evidence audit and closeout gate
